name: wordpress/gutenberg
description: Prototyping since 1440. Development hub for the editor focus in core.

ignore-id.PKSA-z3gr-8qht-p93v: CVE-2026-24765: unsafe deserialization in PHPUnit's PHPT-format code-coverage handling. The .phpt format is not used in this repository.
ignore-id.PKSA-v5yj-8nmz-sk2q: CVE-2026-45304: YAML parser exponential memory allocation only reachable when parsing untrusted YAML input. The only symfony/yaml usage this dependency graph exercises serializes local data and is never invoked within this repository's own PHPUnit runs
ignore-id.PKSA-ft77-7h5f-p3r6: CVE-2026-45305: ReDoS via catastrophic backtracking. This is only reachable by YAML parsing of untrusted input, which this repository's PHPUnit-5.7-driven usage never performs.
ignore-id.PKSA-b14r-zh1d-vdrc: CVE-2026-45133: stack exhaustion via unbounded recursion in symfony/yaml's handling of deeply nested blocks/sequences/mappings. Only exercised by YAML parsing of untrusted input, which does not happen in this repository.
ignore-id.PKSA-mh9b-91zm-m1gy: CVE-2026-45293 only affects the WordPress.WP.EnqueuedResourceParameters sniff included in the WordPress and WordPress-Extra rulesets, all of which are not used.
